response.original_title: El Limbo y los culos según José
response.overview: A surreal and irreverent comedy that delves into the eccentric mind of José, a man who views the universe through an absurdly specific lens. Trapped in a mid-life existential crisis—his own personal "limbo"—José attempts to make sense of life, death, and human connection, anchoring his deepest philosophical musings to the most unlikely and comical of subjects. Through a series of bizarre encounters, tragicomic reflections, and completely unfiltered observations, the film explores the ridiculousness of the human condition. It playfully challenges conventional morality and aesthetics while celebrating the quirky, grounded beauty of everyday existence.
